description: Source code implementing XML parsing utility functions for extracting various data types from XML nodes, including uint64, int64, int, string, bool, and double, using libxml2.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_uint64
methods.description: Retrieves a uint64_t value from an XML node property or content, with default fallback.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_int64
methods.description: Retrieves an int64_t value from an XML node property or content, with default fallback.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_int
methods.description: Retrieves an int value from an XML node property or content, with default fallback.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from an XML node property or content, with default fallback.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from an XML node property or content, interpreting 'true' as true.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_double
methods.description: Retrieves a double value from an XML node property or content, with default fallback.
